fusions.name: Running Shot
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at the gallop that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Coiled Hind Kick
fusions.desc: You coil your hind legs and release them into the target for 34 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Steady in the Stirrups
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: String Drawn by Stride
fusions.desc: Every few tiles you run, your next spell deals 40% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
